name: openpacker
description: OpenPacker reference implementation of Package Resolution Exchange (PREX)

scripts.test: node scripts/turbo-run.mjs test && node scripts/run-gate.mjs unit
scripts.test:live: npm run test:live --workspace @openpacker/oci && npm run test:live --workspace @openpacker/adapter-nix
scripts.test:pack-parity: npm exec -- vitest run --config scripts/vitest.gate.config.mjs packages/adapters-default/src/standard-pack.test.ts packages/adapters-default/src/standard-pack.native.test.ts && node --test integrations/mise/test/contract.test.mjs
scripts.test:fuzz: node scripts/fuzz-smoke.mjs && node tests/fuzz/upm-auth-config.mjs && node tests/fuzz/upm-maven-pom.mjs
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --all-features
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check:contracts && npm run check:generated && npm run check:test-inventory && npm run test:docs && npm run check:licenses && npm run skills:mirror-check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run coverage && npm run test:conformance && npm run test:security && npm run security:codex:test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:behavior && npm run test:compat && npm run test:browser && npm run test:pack-parity && npm run check:rust && npm run demo && npm run demo:lock-import && npm run benchmark && npm run golden:check && npm run test:fuzz
